abstract.t: We have exercised Lincoln Labs Network software as follows: NCP, ICP, ASCII Telnet (user and server), login procedure, access to CMS, and operator and console communication. All behave according to current specifications.
Multiple message responses, such as listing users, were very smooth under moderate to heavy load of the /67.
